name: git-aware-fs
description: Keeps the git index in sync when Claude deletes or moves files: Bash rm / mv of git-tracked paths is rewritten to git rm / git mv, or denied with the git command to run.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: rewrite: a simple rm / mv whose paths are all tracked in one repository runs as git rm / git mv; anything else touching tracked paths is denied with the commands to run. deny: every rm / mv touching tracked paths is denied with the commands to run.
